english: You are Nico Lin. You work for Events Horizon, a company which organises large public events. You are part of a committee responsible for organising the Victoria Cup, a professional women’s tennis tournament.
In order to promote the Victoria Cup to the public, the head of the Victoria Cup project team, Anthony Au, is keen to ensure that the tournament is a success.
You will listen to a Zoom meeting between a young tennis star called Lara Taranova, her agent Victor Laurent and Anthony Au.
Before the recording is played, you will have five minutes to study the Question-Answer Book and the Data File to familiarise yourself with the situation and the tasks.

Complete the tasks by following the instructions in the Question-Answer Book and on the recording. You will find all the information you need in the Question-Answer Book, the Data File and on the recording. As you listen you can make notes on page 3 of the Data File.
You now have five minutes to familiarise yourself with the Question-Answer Book and the Data File.
1. Listening note-taking sheet for the Zoom meeting — page 3
2. Email from Anthony Au to Nico Lin — page 4
3. Volunteer opportunities notice sent to Hong Kong charities — page 5
4. Hong Kong Charity Google Forms — page 5
5. Minutes of the Victoria Cup Committee meeting — page 6
6. Letter to the Editor of the Hong Kong Press & Journal from Ms. Geeta Singh — page 7
7. Transcript of phone conversation between Sana Javed and Leon Barnes — page 8
8. Bon Accord News article 22 April 2021 — page 9
9. Interview with singer Summer Li from Sonic Attack online magazine — page 10

情境
你是 Nico Lin，任職於 Events Horizon；這家公司籌辦大型公眾活動。你是負責籌辦 Victoria Cup 的委員會成員。Victoria Cup 是一項職業女子網球錦標賽。
為了向公眾推廣 Victoria Cup，項目團隊主管 Anthony Au 希望確保賽事成功。
你將聆聽年輕網球明星 Lara Taranova、她的經理人 Victor Laurent 和 Anthony Au 的 Zoom 會議。
錄音播放前，你有五分鐘閱讀答題簿及資料檔案，熟悉情境和各項任務。
按照答題簿及錄音中的指示完成任務。所需資料載於答題簿、資料檔案和錄音中。聆聽時，你可在資料檔案第 3 頁記筆記。
你現在有五分鐘熟悉答題簿及資料檔案。

Geeta Singh 女士致《Hong Kong Press & Journal》編輯的信，第 7 頁；7. Sana Javed 與 Leon Barnes 的電話對話逐字稿，第 8 頁；8. 2021 年 4 月 22 日《Bon Accord News》文章，第 9 頁；9. 《Sonic Attack》網上雜誌訪問歌手 Summer Li，第 10 頁。

english: Email from Anthony Au to Nico Lin
Subject: The Victoria Cup – Things to do
These are the three things that I’d like you to do in preparation for the Victoria Cup.
We have decided to choose Changing Young Lives to provide the volunteer ball kids for the Victoria Cup. You need to write an email to Gilbert at Refugee Sanctuary explaining:
• Why we didn’t choose them, i.e. which job requirements they don’t meet.
• Ways that we can contribute to their charity and what Lara has offered to do.
You may want to start by looking at the notice we sent to the charities.
Letter to the Editor from Ms. Singh

You may have seen the letter to the editor in the Hong Kong Press & Journal from a Ms. Geeta Singh complaining about various issues. Please write a letter to the editor in response to Ms Singh’s letter reminding the readers of Ms Singh’s complaints and stating our responses to them. You may have to look at the transcript that Sana made of her conversation with Mr Barnes.
Email to PR Department about Promotional Poster

Our promotional poster for the Victoria Cup has received criticism. Please send an email to Alfred Roi at the PR department making sure that he understands exactly why the poster has to be redesigned.
You can start by looking at the Bon Accord News article.

Anthony Au
Project Leader
Events Horizon
chinese: Anthony Au 致 Nico Lin 的電郵；發送時間：2021 年 4 月 28 日上午 10:18。主旨：Victoria Cup——待辦事項。
Nico：
以下是我希望你為籌備 Victoria Cup 完成的三件事。
義工球僮：我們決定由 Changing Young Lives 提供 Victoria Cup 的義工球僮。請寫電郵給 Refugee Sanctuary 的 Gilbert，解釋我們為何沒有選擇他們——即他們不符合哪些工作要求——以及我們可以如何支持其慈善機構、Lara 願意做甚麼。你可以先查看我們發給各慈善機構的通知。
回應 Singh 女士的讀者來信：你可能看過 Geeta Singh 女士在《Hong Kong Press & Journal》向編輯投訴各項問題的信。請回信給編輯，向讀者重述 Singh 女士的投訴，並說明我們的回應。你可能需要參考 Sana 與 Barnes 先生對話的紀錄。
致公關部的宣傳海報電郵：Victoria Cup 的宣傳海報受到批評。請電郵公關部的 Alfred Roi，清楚說明海報為何需要重新設計。你可以先查看《Bon Accord News》的文章。
再次感謝你的幫忙。Anthony Au，項目主管，Events Horizon。

english: Hong Kong Press & Journal article 25 April 2021

The upcoming Victoria Cup tennis tournament is in the firing line again, this time from local residents near Victoria Park, who do not want a repeat of last year. A local resident, surnamed Ho, complained, “Last year the tennis fans dropped rubbish everywhere. It was a disgrace!” Cel Bautista, a regular park user, added, “You should have seen all of the plastic bottles and cigarette butts.”

This follows an online storm surrounding the Victoria Cup earlier this week which erupted due to the fact that tennis fans will not be able to watch the Victoria Cup at all on local TV this year. As Crystal Lee, a lifelong tennis fan, said on a fan forum, “There’s no way I’m going to waste my money paying the annual subscription fee just to watch a cable channel for one week.”
A spokesperson from organisers Events Horizon was not available for comment.
WhatsApp message from Dickson Tse to the Events Horizon WhatsApp Group
We’ll order two of these Outdoor Cooling Fans and set them up next to the players’ seats so that they can use them to cool down during the breaks.
chinese: 《Hong Kong Press & Journal》2021 年 4 月 25 日文章
Victoria Cup 垃圾問題
即將舉行的 Victoria Cup 網球賽再受抨擊。今次發聲的是維多利亞公園附近的居民，他們不希望重演去年的情況。一位姓何的居民投訴：「去年網球迷到處丟垃圾，實在不成體統！」公園常客 Cel Bautista 補充：「你真該看看那些膠樽和煙蒂。」
這之前，Victoria Cup 本週已引起網上爭議：球迷今年完全無法在本地電視觀看賽事。資深球迷 Crystal Lee 在球迷論壇表示：「我才不會為了只看一星期的有線頻道，花錢付一整年的訂閱費。」
主辦方 Events Horizon 的發言人未能回應。
Dickson Tse 發給 Events Horizon WhatsApp 群組的訊息，下午 3:10：
「我們會訂購兩部這種戶外涼風扇，放在球員座位旁，讓他們在休息時消暑。」
